name: Electronic Properties of Materials
summary: Uses band theory to explain why metals conduct, semiconductors switch and insulators insulate, and how processing changes electrical behaviour.

topics.name: Ohm's law, conductivity, mobility and the Drude model
Free-electron model: Fermi energy, density of states and Fermi-Dirac statistics
Electrons in periodic potentials: Bloch's theorem, band gaps and Brillouin zones
Tight-binding picture and band structures of real materials
Metals: resistivity contributions from temperature, impurities and deformation (Matthiessen's rule)
Intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductors; carrier concentration and temperature dependence
Semiconductor junctions and devices from a materials viewpoint
Electrical conduction in polymers and conducting polymers
Superconductivity: phenomenology, type I/II, critical field and current
Electronic properties at the nanoscale: quantum confinement and tunnelling
